references.title: CDC lakehouse and warehouse with scheduled transformation
references.flow: Operational databases -> change capture -> raw storage -> transformation -> warehouse and queryable lake; scheduler controls transformation.
references.layout: Dark cloud frame and teal dashed region have corner badges; purple VPC contains blue dashed AZs and cyan private subnets. Raw/curated stores and orchestration are regional siblings. Query consumers sit outside cloud.
references.avoid: Database icons straddle AZ boundaries: assign each instance unambiguously. Do not copy three AZs, database choices or region. Distinguish CDC data direction from replication control calls.

references.title: Governed multi-source table lake with query consumers
references.flow: Operational databases -> CDC -> raw object storage -> transformation -> table lake -> query -> BI applications; catalogue and governance support access.
references.layout: Ingestion VPC left uses dashed AZs, pale green public and cyan private shading with badges. Regional lakehouse uses a separate dashed functional group; controls form a top rail.
references.avoid: DMS straddles AZs and container apps lack hosting in the image. Resolve deployment mode and subnet membership. Do not copy counts, NAT or geography. Governance grouping is not a VPC.

references.title: Incremental relational ingestion into an Iceberg lake
references.flow: Relational source -> ingestion -> raw object store -> table transformation -> curated lake -> query/BI; metadata store tracks ingestion state.
references.layout: Single left-to-right pipeline inside dark cloud frame. Source in its own VPC; metadata branch above processing; managed storage/query outside VPC.
references.avoid: Not a full deployment topology. Glue networking depends on connectivity. Iceberg is a table format, not a compute boundary. Do not copy source database choice unless selected.

references.title: Parallel CDC and streaming analytics lanes
references.flow: Database CDC -> raw storage -> curated lake -> query; events -> stream -> stream processor -> warehouse -> BI. Curated lake feeds warehouse only when in scope.
references.layout: Two horizontal lanes converge on consumers. External sources in dashed rounded box left; dark cloud frame surrounds services; users right. Shared stores drawn once.
references.avoid: Logical view omits networking. Resolve DMS, streaming and warehouse hosting separately. Do not import payment-domain requirements or assume every shared-store link is needed.

references.title: Legacy database CDC migration to a governed warehouse
references.flow: External database -> CDC -> raw lake -> transformation -> curated data -> warehouse -> BI; metadata, catalogue, quality and monitoring support the path.
references.layout: Dark cloud and teal dashed region with badges; main path above dashed security, lineage, monitoring and governance groups. Sources left and users right outside cloud.
references.avoid: Purple Glue processing box is functional, not a VPC. Do not inherit Direct Connect, region, compatibility or all controls. Verify chosen DMS and warehouse deployment.

references.title: Enterprise database and file ingestion to a warehouse
references.flow: Enterprise database and file feeds -> ingestion -> raw storage -> transformation -> curated lake -> warehouse -> BI; ingestion metadata maintained separately.
references.layout: External source list left; horizontal processing/storage above dashed governance groups inside teal region and dark cloud frame. Controls separate from data traffic.
references.avoid: Post-migration operating pattern, not CDC migration. Do not copy application names, region or assume all feeds share a connection. Functional Glue block must not become a subnet.

references.title: Private application with agent-based document quality checks
references.flow: Authenticated application -> orchestration -> OCR/model/document tools; application uses private data store. Specialist checks are logical agent roles, not necessarily separate deployments.
references.layout: External identity above cloud; teal dashed region, purple VPC, dashed AZs, green public and cyan app/data subnets. Regional tool/runtime modules beside VPC; controls in top rail.
references.avoid: Authentication is not serial traffic through WAF; associate WAF with supported ingress. ALB spans selected subnets, not VPCs. Do not copy duplicate Node 1 labels or two AZs; resolve AgentCore networking independently.

references.title: Agent orchestration and container integration service
references.flow: Existing application -> authenticated ingress -> integration service -> orchestrator with OCR, model, retrieval and memory; external verification tools remain outside AWS.
references.layout: Dashed functional modules around central orchestrator; external SaaS right and separate security rail. Reuse module separation, not blanket VPC containment.
references.avoid: Text-only: image incorrectly encloses Bedrock, Textract, Cognito and API Gateway in VPC and S3 straddles cloud border. Do not imitate placement. Resolve AgentCore mode and service-owned versus customer VPC resources; no copied agents, customer names or vendors.

references.title: Claims document extraction and verification integration
references.flow: Existing claims API -> authenticated application -> extraction/model validation -> data store and external verification; results return to existing system.
references.layout: Central cyan private app and database tiers; inference above; external integrations right; shared tools below. Dark cloud and teal dashed region with badges.
references.avoid: Private subnets lack VPC parent in image: add proper VPC containment. Do not turn repeated ECS/Fargate symbols into three serial apps. Move regional tools inside region. No copied client integrations.

references.title: Private batch speech analytics with a separate model lifecycle
references.flow: Customer recordings -> landing store -> transcription -> masking/scoring -> model inference -> results -> existing dashboards. Training, approval and deployment form a separate lifecycle.
references.layout: Cloud, region, account, VPC and shaded public/private boxes with badges; numbered data path; dashed job/download links. Lifecycle and security below runtime; external model hub above cloud.
references.avoid: Use cloud/account/region/VPC/AZ/subnet nesting rather than source region/account order. Dashed worker groups are not AZs. Resolve POC versus production redundancy; no copied model names, GPU size, retention or region. Registry and image publishing are distinct; label control versus data links.
